description_en: A folding woven-and-textile toiletry case with a hanging hook, three empty lined pouches and top zipper. Canonical front: the broad front woven panel and zipper pull. Side view: the layered pouch thickness and folding hinge bands. Rear view: a plain textile backing with the recessed hanging hook. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A folding woven-and-textile toiletry case with a hanging hook, three empty lined pouches and top zipper. Canonical front: the broad front woven panel and zipper pull. Side view: the layered pouch thickness and folding hinge bands. Rear view: a plain textile backing with the recessed hanging hook. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. Front-reference invariants: three hanging sections; upper section is a flat closed woven zipper pouch with the hook above, middle and bottom sections are open plain fabric-lined rectangular pouches. Keep exactly this hanging fully unfolded pose, section widths, fabric hinge spacing and open/closed states; do not add extra pouches or close the open two. CAMERA: exact REAR ELEVATION: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, level with product center, directly facing its back. Show rear supports, rear surfaces and described rear features. The front-facing features must be hidden on the opposite side. Do not mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
